kurals.tr: Porulalla Vatraip Porulendru Unarum / Marulaanaam Maanaap Pirappu
kurals.m: Inglorious births are produced by the confusion (of mind) which considers those things to be real which are not real

kurals.tr: Irulneengi Inpam Payakkum Marulneengi / Maasaru Kaatchi Yavarkku
kurals.m: A clear, undimmed vision of things will deliver its possessors from the darkness of future births, and confer the felicity (of heaven)

kurals.tr: Aiyaththin Neengith Thelindhaarkku Vaiyaththin / Vaanam Naniya Thutaiththu
kurals.m: Heaven is nearer than earth to those men of purified minds who are freed from from doubt

kurals.tr: Aiyunarvu Eydhiyak Kannum Payamindre / Meyyunarvu Illaa Thavarkku
kurals.m: Even those who have all the knowledge which can be attained by the five senses, will derive no benefit from it, if they are without a knowledge of the true nature of things

kurals.tr: Epporul Eththanmaith Thaayinum Apporul / Meypporul Kaanpadhu Arivu
kurals.m: (True) knowledge is the perception concerning every thing of whatever kind, that that thing is the true thing

kurals.tr: Katreentu Meypporul Kantaar Thalaippatuvar / Matreentu Vaaraa Neri
kurals.m: They, who in this birth have learned to know the True Being, enter the road which returns not into this world

kurals.tr: Orththullam Ulladhu Unarin Orudhalaiyaap / Perththulla Ventaa Pirappu
kurals.m: Let it not be thought that there is another birth for him whose mind having thoroughly considered (all it has been taught) has known the True Being

kurals.tr: Pirappennum Pedhaimai Neengach Chirappennum / Semporul Kaanpadhu Arivu
kurals.m: True knowledge consists in the removal of ignorance; which is (the cause of) births, and the perception of the True Being who is (the bestower of) heaven

kurals.tr: Saarpunarndhu Saarpu Ketaozhukin Matrazhiththuch / Chaardharaa Saardharu Noi
kurals.m: He who so lives as to know Him who is the support of all things and abandon all desire, will be freed from the evils which would otherwise cleave to him and destroy (his efforts after absorption)

kurals.tr: Kaamam Vekuli Mayakkam Ivaimundran / Naamam Ketakketum Noi
kurals.m: If the very names of these three things, desire, anger, and confusion of mind, be destroyed, then will also perish evils (which flow from them)
